Game Overview

Santa Car Cookie puts players into a christmas experience centered on race through a vibrant city as Santa Claus, collecting cookies and navigating obstacles in a festive sleigh ride. With intuitive controls and the thrill of double jumps, guide Santa safely home. Discover new costumes to keep his journey fresh while delivering holiday cheer on this exciting adventure.

Santa Car Cookie keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Race through a vibrant city as Santa Claus, collecting cookies and navigating obstacles in a festive sleigh ride.
